items.title: Claude Duet Safety, Privacy, and Security
items.content: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.
items.contentSnippet: Claude Duet is a proactive agent that works for you, even while you’re away. It builds on two layers of protection: safety training in the Claude model itself and the safeguards that exist in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. On top of those, we added new protections for working across your accounts and acting on your behalf.

summaries.zh: Claude Duet是一款能在用户离线时仍主动工作的智能代理。它基于Claude模型的安全训练和Claude Code、Claude Managed Agents等产品中的保护措施，构建了双重安全防护。此外，还增加了跨账户协作和代为执行任务的新防护机制，以提升安全性。
summaries.en: Claude Duet is a proactive agent designed to operate independently, even when users are absent. It incorporates dual layers of protection: safety training within the Claude model and existing safeguards in products like Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents. Additional new safeguards have been implemented to enhance cross-account collaboration and authorized actions on behalf of users. The system prioritizes security, privacy, and user control through these combined measures.

items.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
items.content: As merges to Anthropic's monorepo grew from about 2,500 to more than 30,000 a day, source control became the biggest development bottleneck. Here is how the team built Scion, an in-house version control system designed for always-online agents, and migrated off git in five months.
items.contentSnippet: As merges to Anthropic's monorepo grew from about 2,500 to more than 30,000 a day, source control became the biggest development bottleneck. Here is how the team built Scion, an in-house version control system designed for always-online agents, and migrated off git in five months.

summaries.zh: Anthropic的单一代码库合并请求量从每天约2,500个激增至超过30,000个，导致源代码管理成为最大的开发瓶颈。团队为此开发了内部版本控制系统Scion，专为常在线代理设计，并在五个月内成功从Git迁移。Scion解决了合并请求激增的问题，提升了开发效率。
summaries.en: Anthropic's monorepo experienced a surge in daily merges from 2,500 to over 30,000, making source control a major bottleneck. To address this, the team developed Scion, an in-house version control system tailored for always-online agents, and successfully migrated away from Git in five months.

items.summary: Anthropic的单一代码库合并请求量从每天约2,500个激增至超过30,000个，导致源代码管理成为最大的开发瓶颈。团队为此开发了内部版本控制系统Scion，专为常在线代理设计，并在五个月内成功从Git迁移。Scion解决了合并请求激增的问题，提升了开发效率。
